C1388.title: Mass Propagation of a Mirai Variant Botnet
C1388.summary: In 2022, CNCERT and Qi-AnXin detected a rapidly spreading new Mirai variant botnet, with daily domestic compromised IPs peaking at over 20,000 and launching DDoS attacks against multiple targets. The variant targeted mips, arm, x86 and other CPU architectures, posing a significant threat to cyberspace.

references.title: Risk Alert on Large-Scale Propagation of Mirai Variant Botnets
